ValidationRule.description: Requires a Digital EAA greater than 0 when Digital_BU__c is checked. Fires only when the box or EAA is edited or the stage advances (not to Lost), so insert, Lead conversion and system follow-up saves pass. Bypass_Opportunity_Validation skips it.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Opportunity_Validation), NOT(ISNEW()), Digital_BU__c = TRUE, OR(ISBLANK(Digital_EAA__c), Digital_EAA__c <= 0), OR( ISCHANGED(Digital_BU__c), ISCHANGED(Digital_EAA__c), AND(ISCHANGED(StageName), NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Lost"))) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enter a Digital EAA greater than 0 when Digital BU is checked.
